history.summary: Hindu Bhagavathi temple at Palakkunnu, near Trikkannad in Hosdurg taluk - described as one of the most famous temples of North Kerala and a cultural-spiritual centre of Kasaragod district. Bhagavathi is worshipped in two forms, Mootha Bhagavathi (Durga) and Elaya Bhagavathi (Saraswathi), alongside Vishnumoorthi, Ghantakarnan and Dhandan Devan and the Chamundi sub-deities. The temple is closely tied to the Theyyam ritual tradition, which is performed during festivals. People of all castes and religions visit; the Kerala Tourism festival calendar notes there is no bar on entry by caste or creed. No founding date or dynasty is documented in the sources consulted (UNVERIFIED). Address: Palakkunnu P.O, Bekal, Kasaragod - 671318.

name: Palakkunnu Sri Bhagavathy Temple
town_description: Palakkunnu is a coastal village near Trikkannad in Hosdurg taluk of Kasaragod district, on the Kasaragod-Kanhangad State Highway about 3 km from Bekal Fort. Kottikulam railway station lies just 50 metres from the temple. The area is part of the North Malabar Theyyam belt, and the temple draws devotees of all castes and religions from across the region.

travel.road: On the Kasaragod-Kanhangad State Highway; ~3 km from Bekal Fort; local buses and taxis from Kasaragod and Kanhangad

visitor_information.best_time: December-April (festival season; Bharani Mahotsavam in March, Maruputhari in Dec-Jan)
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM-7:30 PM daily (verify - from a map listing, not an official source)
